ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are sorry to hear about this issue. It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:

-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.

-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.

-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.

-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.

-Close the grill lid.

-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

Please contact our support team if you are still experiencing an issue after going through the steps. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I am highly impressed with the cooking quality of this grill. I love that it is a relatively no-frills model, focused primarily on creating even heat across the working surface. Personally I prefer cast iron grates vs. Stainless, so this model was perfect for me in many ways. I will say the steel frame components seem a little thin and flimsy when unpacking, but came together well and appear to be sturdier than expected. The firebox is excellent quality, and well thought out for easy cleaning. I have previously spent less money on competitor models claiming to be "commercial grade" and they all were rusted through in less than 5 years. I decided to do my research this time, and everything I found pointed to this model as high quality and value. So far, I agree completely and look forward to many years of grilling happiness with it!
Results.Title: A great grill for the price
